title: Prospect Echo: model compatibility & competitive reconnaissance sprint
creator: Sana Rodriguez
description: Run a focused product-research sprint to map model compatibility for 5 prioritized enterprise use-cases, synthesize competitor capabilities, and create a lightweight sentinel that surfaces critical model-supply changes to PM/Eng. Outcomes will inform fallback routing playbooks, Dedicated capacity sizing assumptions, and the product roadmap for Q2-Q3 2026.
acceptance_criteria: A ranked compatibility matrix (CSV + short commentary) for 12 candidate models across 5 enterprise use-cases: RAG, summarization, instruction-following, retrieval-augmented search, and high-throughput embeddings.
A one-page competitive brief that highlights where competitors match/exceed Redwood on latency, quantization support, multi-region availability, and licensing constraints.

A sentinel spec (playbook + dashboard mockup) that will emit alerts for 6 supply signals (model deprecation, quantization breakage, latency delta >20ms, capacity shortages in EU/NA/APAC, license change, major upstream bug) with sample alert thresholds and owners.
Hand-off artifacts (Confluence doc, raw test harness, and an issues backlog of follow-ups) delivered to Eng and Growth with prioritized next actions.
Stakeholder alignment: 1 PM+1 Eng+1 Sales review completed and recorded in comments; any outstanding disagreements have concrete next steps assigned.

tasks: Define 5 enterprise use-cases and associated success criteria (latency SLOs, accuracy thresholds, token budgets)
Select 12 candidate models across open and commercial providers; capture model metadata (license, quant formats, amperage for inference)
Implement synthetic workloads that mimic customer patterns (short-chat, long-context RAG, embedding fan-out)
Run throughput and latency sweeps on hosted and Dedicated-like configs; gather cost-per-1k-tokens estimates
Document failure modes and compatibility exceptions (e.g., mismatch in structured output, tokenizer edge-cases)
Draft sentinel spec and low-fidelity dashboard wireframe for Console team to implement alerts
Interview 3 enterprise prospects/customers to validate impact and thresholds
Produce competitive brief summarizing vendor behaviors, licensing surprises, and regional availability constraints
Create follow-up Linear tickets (PM/ENG/DES) for prioritized fixes and roadmap requests

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Model vendor licensing changes are not machine-detectable; may cause false negatives. Mitigation: combine automated footprint checks with weekly market-scrape and assigned owner for manual verification.
Risk: Test harness synthetic workloads may not match real customer workloads. Mitigation: incorporate 3 anonymized sample traces from Sales/Customers early in sprint.
Risk: Alert fatigue for customers and internal teams. Mitigation: staged alerting and signal prioritization (only top-3 actionable signals fire immediate page).
